text:
hana: FYI found a customer webhook payload that included a Vault path with a user-managed ciphertext reference and an old SA email. Not plaintext creds but treat as high.

leo: Can you paste redacted sample?

hana: pasted to secure bundle: `vault://transit:ct-9f8e7d... svc=svc-legacy-archive@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com`

sec-oncall: Triage checklist: (1) restrict transit/decrypt on the referenced key, (2) run Vault audit for decrypt ops, (3) rotate wrapping key and rewrap blobs if needed, (4) rotate SA keys and block legacy SA from creating new keys.

vault-bot: Audit hit: principal=ci-builder used transit/decrypt on rewrap-key@v1 at 2026-03-26T02:10:11Z

ana: I can handle KMS rewrap. Will need list of ciphertext ids; will create ephemeral wrapping key v4 and perform rewrap via KMS. Post evidence after.

ops: Applied temporary IAM deny on svc-legacy-archive for key creation and removed roles cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter from non-oncall principals. Change ID: change-20260326-01.

leo: Revoked user-managed keys for the SA and rotated Vault secret: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY-old123 --iam-account=svc-legacy-archive@...` and `vault kv delete secret/legacy/archive`. Pasted outputs to incident bundle.

hana: Canary for migration to workload identity started (10%). No auth errors so far.

sec-oncall: Audit search for transit/decrypt last 30d: found 3 ops by internal CI; no external principals. Exporting CSV to /secure/incidents/5067899999/audit.csv.

ana: Rewrap done for sample ct-9f8e7d -> rewrapped to ephemeral-wrap-v4@v1. Updated Vault transit alias and tested decrypt in staging. Evidence uploaded.

ops: Created ticket INFRA-4125 to scan all partner logs for `vault://transit:` patterns and to auto-open a deny rule when found.

leo: Action items:
- leo: confirm all SA keys revoked + attach gcloud outputs (owner)
- ana: KMS rewrap evidence + config change (owner)
- sec-oncall: audit CSV and notify legal if partners attempted decrypt (owner)
- ops: INFRA-4125 automation (owner)
Timeline: containment now, full migration and sweep 24h. Postmortem scheduled 20:30 UTC.

hana: Closing for now — will reopen if scans find more. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
